images.requirements: {{profileImageFormats}}, up to {{postImageMaxMegabytes}} MB. You crop the image before it is sent; it leaves lighter, without its hidden information (location, device).
images.inputTooLarge: Image too large: {{postImageMaxMegabytes}} MB at most.
images.tooLargeAvatar: Even cropped and lightened, this photo is larger than {{profileAvatarMaxMegabytes}} MB: choose another one.
images.tooLargeCover: Even cropped and lightened, this cover is larger than {{profileCoverMaxMegabytes}} MB: choose another one.

crop.hintAvatar: Drag the image or use the sliders: what is inside the circle is exactly what will be sent.
crop.hintCover: Drag the image or use the sliders: what is inside the banner is exactly what will be sent. Depending on the screen width, the profile may trim a little of its top and bottom.
